faq_heading: Homes near Robert Bateman Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Robert Bateman Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Abbotsford School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Robert Bateman Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Robert Bateman Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Robert Bateman Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Clayburn Middle School (0.2 km north-east), Sandy Hill Elementary (0.5 km north-east) and Dr Thomas A Swift Elementary (0.5 km south-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Robert Bateman Secondary

10 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Robert Bateman Secondary in a straight line (6 elementary, 2 middle, 1 other, 1 secondary; 1 independent). The closest is Clayburn Middle School, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Auguston Traditional Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Sandy Hill Elementary (0.5 km); the nearest secondary school is Yale Secondary (2.6 km); the nearest independent school is Abbotsford Christian School (0.8 km). The nearest school teaching the same grades (9-12) is Yale Secondary, 2.6 km south of Robert Bateman Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Robert Bateman Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Abbotsford school finder. A home a few blocks from Robert Bateman Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Robert Bateman Secondary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
